title: Northbound Flow Module (F-019)
description: Create synapse/core/market/northbound.py with NorthChannel enum (HGT/SGT), NorthboundFlow frozen dataclass. Implement load from Parquet monthly files, fetch via DataSource adapter, rolling momentum computation, and signal producers for watchlist integration. Data definitions only, no real-time streaming in P1.
convergence: NorthChannel enum: HGT (沪股通) and SGT (深股通)
NorthboundFlow frozen dataclass: date, channel, buy_amount, sell_amount, net_amount, total_buy, total_sell, quota_used_pct
load_northbound_flow returns DataFrame matching NorthboundFlow fields from data/market/northbound/ Parquet
fetch_northbound_flow works with DataSource adapter supporting data_type='northbound_flow'
northbound_momentum computes rolling sum over configurable window
northbound_to_signals returns list compatible with watchlist integration
Missing local file raises FileNotFoundError with clear path guidance
API failure logs warning, returns empty DataFrame (never None)
All data includes source field for provenance tracking
New unit tests: load, momentum, signals, missing file error, empty DataFrame on failure
